_readme: Rename this file to config.json, then do TWO things: (1) paste your Discord webhook URL below, (2) replace the example shoes with the ones you want. That's it.

_notes.sizes: [] = alert on ANY size. Or list only the sizes you care about, e.g. ["9", "10"].
_notes.add_more_shoes: Copy a block in 'watch' and change the url. Champs/Kids Foot Locker/Footaction URLs work too.
_notes.get_discord_webhook: In Discord: Server Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy Webhook URL.
_notes.dashboard: Run with --dashboard to also get a live web page at http://localhost:8000
